source: Industry template library. Section sets, booking schemas and sample copy generalised from the working MyServicePro demo sites (github.com/Albert-Machuene-Dev/MyServicePro_Demos: restaurant, B&B, wine estate, fashion retail, airport transfers, tours) and extended to every ProVeri trade category.

sectionKinds.SPLASH: Branded loading screen. Cosmetic — off by default because it costs a first-time visitor 2.8s on a cold 3G connection.
sectionKinds.HEADER_NAV: Sticky header with a slide-out navigation panel. Works without JavaScript via CSS :target.
sectionKinds.HERO: Full-bleed hero: headline, tagline, primary and secondary call to action.
sectionKinds.CATALOGUE: Tabbed catalogue — menu, rooms, treatments, services or collection. CSS-only tabs, so it works with JavaScript disabled.
sectionKinds.GALLERY: Photo grid with a lightbox. Images are lazy-loaded and permission-checked before publish.
sectionKinds.ABOUT: Story, image and up to three hard stats.
sectionKinds.TESTIMONIALS: Customer quotes. When the site is linked to a verified pro, only escrow-backed reviews are eligible.
sectionKinds.HOURS_LOCATION: Opening hours, address, click-to-call and a map link.
sectionKinds.BOOKING: Live booking form. Submissions create a real record — a reservation, an enquiry, or an escrow-ready ProVeri job.
sectionKinds.TRUST_BLOCK: ProVeri exclusive: verification checks, escrow explanation and verified reviews pulled live from the audit ledger.
sectionKinds.FLEET: ProVeri exclusive: verified vehicles from the vehicles vertical, with Service Passport state.
sectionKinds.FAQ: Short answers to the questions that stop people booking.
sectionKinds.CONTACT: Contact channels, WhatsApp click-to-chat and social links.
sectionKinds.FOOTER: Business details, ProVeri attribution and publish state.

bookingIntake.JOB: Creates a real marketplace job with the linked pro, so the booking lands in the same bid → escrow → proof-of-work → review pipeline as every other ProVeri job.
bookingIntake.RESERVATION: Creates a reservation the business confirms or declines. The visitor gets a reference number immediately.
bookingIntake.ENQUIRY: Creates a qualified enquiry plus a follow-up task for the business, and a sales lead if the site is still a demo.
